title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description: Find the longest substring that can be made uniform by replacing at most k characters.

data.text: Given a string `s` and an integer `k`, return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter after at most `k` replacements.

**Input:** `s = "ABAB", k = 2`

**Output:** `4` (replace both A or both B)

data.title: Check each window O(n^2)
Grow-shrink O(n)
What improved?
data.text: The window slides once. We track the most frequent character in the current window and shrink only when replacements needed exceed k.
